annotations.title: Find public copies of a code string

description:
Search public repositories for an exact code string; return WHERE it appears.

Use it to hunt vendored / copy-pasted copies of known-vulnerable code: search a
distinctive symbol or short fragment from the vulnerable function (a function name, a
constant, one call), then FETCH AND READ the hits to judge which copies are still
unpatched, reachable, or just fossils/forks. Returns RAW search results only -- it makes
no vulnerability judgment; that reasoning is yours. A long line rarely matches exactly
and is slow; the shortest distinctive token works best. Searches are capped at about
10 s: `partial: true` means the cap was hit with fewer than `limit` hits.

Args:
    code:  an exact code string, e.g. "VP8LBuildHuffmanTable" or "yaml.load(".
    lang:  optional language filter, e.g. "c", "python", "javascript" (default: all languages).
    limit: max hits to return (default 50).
name: search_public_code
title: Find public copies of a code string
